title: Hotline connection profile (v1)
description: Per-connection configuration stored in connections/<id>.json; the file stem is the id (unit: JSON object).

name.description: Display name shown in the Provider dropdown (unit: string).

model.description: Model id override; null uses connection default (unit: model id).

effort.description: Reasoning or thinking effort level (trimmed, lower-cased; low, medium, high, plus xhigh and max for Claude Code and Anthropic, and ultra for Codex); null uses model default (unit: string).

endpoint.description: API base URL; null uses the type's default endpoint (unit: URL).

cliPath.description: CLI executable path; null auto-detects from PATH (unit: file path).

agent.description: Antigravity custom agent name in chatOnly mode; null uses 'hotline' (unit: agent name).

continueIn.description: Connection-specific 'Continue this chat in' targets; null uses chat.continueIn (unit: target array).

extraArgs.description: Extra CLI arguments appended on launch (unit: argument array).

args.description: Replacement CLI launch flags for inherit mode (unit: argument array).

keepCliSessions.description: Keep CLI conversation in the CLI's own session store (unit: boolean).

keepInHotline.description: Also save CLI conversation messages in Hotline's history\ (unit: boolean).

refusalFallback.description: Allow Anthropic API safety refusal fallback routing (unit: boolean).

tools.description: Tool mode: chatOnly or inherit CLI/MCP tools (unit: enum).

approveAllTools.description: Auto-approve all CLI tool requests in inherit mode (unit: boolean).

workingDirectory.description: Working folder for CLI inherit mode; null uses user profile (unit: directory path).

prompt.description: System prompt name in prompts\; null uses chat.defaultPrompt (unit: prompt name).

maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens per answer for API connections (unit: tokens).

temperature.description: Sampling temperature for Gemini, OpenAI-compatible and local APIs (unit: scalar 0-2).

images.description: Whether model accepts images; null uses type default (unit: boolean).

name.description: Display label in Continue this chat in menu (unit: string).

url.description: URL template for web or base URL for openWebUi (unit: URL).

command.description: Executable and arguments for app target (unit: command string).

model.description: Optional model override for openWebUi (unit: model id).

copyChat.description: Copy chat Markdown to clipboard before launching (unit: boolean).
